svg.desc: 7 finite source observations across 1 series; 7 observations displayed across 1 series.

Four accounts generate 82.5% of revenue. columnLine chart. 7 categories, 2 series, 14 numeric values. 7 observation targets and 7 aggregate inspection targets. Use Tab to enter or leave chart inspection. Use arrow keys, Home, and End to navigate displayed targets. Enter or Space activates observations. Aggregate targets are for inspection only.
